classification.between_3_and_9: KILL if primary mean net edge is non-positive, otherwise INSUFFICIENT_DATA
classification.at_least_10: KEEP only if mean, median, bootstrap lower bound are positive and both chronological half means are non-negative; otherwise KILL

hypotheses.market_timeframe: BTCUSDT perpetual, completed 1h bars; 5m metrics causally sampled at bar close
hypotheses.mechanism: Extreme aggressive taker pressure that fails to move price while OI is elevated and growing indicates absorption; price subsequently moves against the aggressor.

entry_condition.buy_absorption_short: taker long/short volume ratio >= calibration q85 and completed 1h return <= 0
entry_condition.sell_absorption_long: taker long/short volume ratio <= calibration q15 and completed 1h return >= 0
entry_condition.entry: next 1h bar open after completed signal bar

hypotheses.invalidation: missing metrics older than 10 minutes, OOS feature coverage below 95 percent, fewer than five regime controls, or chronology violation
hypotheses.primary_metric: 4h direction-adjusted signal return minus mean of five regime controls minus one 12bps cost ledger
hypotheses.matched_controls: same July half, calibration-frozen 24h volatility tercile, 24h trend sign, UTC hour; nearest non-signal timestamps outside +/-4h of every signal
hypotheses.kill_criterion: classified sample fails the shared rule, or 3-9 observations have non-positive 4h mean matched edge
hypotheses.keep_criterion: shared >=10 rule on 4h matched edge plus non-negative 1h mean matched edge
leakage_controls: calibration quantiles frozen before July retrieval
latest metric at or before bar close

hypotheses.market_timeframe: BTCUSDT perpetual traded, ETHUSDT perpetual SMT reference, completed 15m bars
hypotheses.mechanism: A BTC liquidity sweep rejected back inside a six-hour range is stronger when ETH does not confirm the sweep and a separate completed local reversal bar confirms rejection.

entry_condition.bearish: BTC high exceeds prior 24-bar high and closes below it; ETH high does not exceed its own prior 24-bar high
entry_condition.bullish: BTC low breaks prior 24-bar low and closes above it; ETH low does not break its own prior 24-bar low
entry_condition.local_trigger: next completed 15m bar closes beyond the SFP candle midpoint and beyond the SFP close in reversal direction
entry_condition.entry: open of the bar after the completed trigger

hypotheses.invalidation: BTC/ETH timestamps are not aligned, trigger absent, entry/exit continuity failure, or fewer than 95 percent aligned OOS bars
hypotheses.primary_metric: direction-adjusted 4h return minus one 12bps cost ledger
hypotheses.kill_criterion: classified sample fails the shared rule, or 3-9 observations have non-positive 4h mean net return
hypotheses.keep_criterion: shared >=10 rule on 4h net return plus non-negative 1h mean net return
leakage_controls: SFP uses only prior 24 completed bars
SMT evaluated on the same completed bar
trigger is a later completed bar

hypotheses.mechanism: Hidden RSI divergence at a confirmed swing inside an aligned EMA trend marks a pullback that subsequently continues with the regime.

entry_condition.pivot_confirmation: strict three bars left and three bars right; signal exists only after the third right bar completes
entry_condition.bullish: current pivot low is above prior pivot low, RSI is lower, close > EMA200, EMA50 > EMA200, EMA200 slope over 24h > 0
entry_condition.bearish: current pivot high is below prior pivot high, RSI is higher, close < EMA200, EMA50 < EMA200, EMA200 slope over 24h < 0
entry_condition.entry: next 1h bar open after pivot confirmation

hypotheses.invalidation: insufficient EMA/RSI warmup, unconfirmed pivot, entry/exit continuity failure, or OOS bar coverage below 95 percent
hypotheses.primary_metric: direction-adjusted 12h return minus one 12bps cost ledger
hypotheses.kill_criterion: classified sample fails the shared rule, or 3-9 observations have non-positive 12h mean net return
hypotheses.keep_criterion: shared >=10 rule on 12h net return plus non-negative 4h mean net return
leakage_controls: July outcomes not used for indicator parameters
